content:
simon: Heads-up — marketing pushed our launch up 10 days. We need a contingency plan for Dedicated GPU pools across us-west2 and eu-central1. Expected 3x baseline QPS for 72 hours after launch.

priya: :eyes: Do we have current avg utilization numbers for the pools?

joel: Baseline: us-west2 dedicated pool (p4d+v100 mix) avg 45% cpu/gpu util, eu-central1 avg 38%. KV cache hit ~22%. If traffic spikes 3x we need ~2.8k A100-equivalent hours/day extra.

simon: Thanks. Two asks: 1) short-term quota increases (GPUs, EIPs, ENIs/subnet IPs) in both accounts. 2) a fallback plan to use spot/borrowed capacity + cross-region warm pool if quota not available. We need a request drafted for cloud provider support + finance signoff for short-term reservation.

joel: I'll open quota tickets. Proposed limits to request: us-west2 -> +120 A100-type GPUs, +200 EIPs, +800 ENI/IPs. eu-central1 -> +60 A100s, +80 EIPs, +400 ENI/IPs. Also ask for ability to convert on-demand -> reserved early if needed.

simon: Do we have account numbers/owner emails to include?

joel: Use cloud-account-prod-us@redwood.com and cloud-account-eu@redwood.com. I'll paste the quota request template below so support has context:

joel: ```
Project: Redwood Inference - Dedicated Production
Requested by: eng-infra (joel)
Impact: upcoming product launch with expected 3x traffic for 72 hours starting 2026-04-02
Requested increases:
 - GPU quota: +120 A100 (us-west2), +60 A100 (eu-central1)
 - Floating IPs/EIPs: +200 (us-west2), +80 (eu-central1)
 - Subnet IPs / ENIs: +800 (us-west2), +400 (eu-central1)
Justification: Short-term burst buffer for Dedicated pools to avoid throttling/fallback. Will de-escalate after 14 days.
Contact: joel@redwood.com, simon@redwood.com
```

infra-bot: Ticket created: CLOUD-98734 (gpu-quota-us-west2), CLOUD-98735 (gpu-quota-eu-central1). ETA from provider: 24-72h.

priya: Great. Next — fallback orchestration. If quotas delayed, we should: 1) enable spot fallback on dedicated pools with auto-fallback threshold 70% queue latency, 2) spin up cross-region warm pool (t3 warm replicas) with pre-warmed KV caches, 3) enable aggressive prefix caching for common prompts.

joel: For spot fallback I'm drafting runtime policy changes. Snippet: 

joel: ```json
{"fallback_policy": "spot_then_cross_region", "spot_bid_pct": 60, "latency_threshold_ms": 1200, "grace_period_secs": 30}
```

anne: Finance - quick note: temporary reservation for on-demand capacity is ~$48k/day for full requested capacity. We can approve up to $150k emergency commit this quarter, but need an owner to sign off and a rollback date.

tom: Network note: us-west2 subnets are close to /22 size in some zones. If we request +800 ENIs we must also request subnet expansion or additional AZ subnets. EIP pool increases will require support to raise soft limits per region.

simon: Joel/tom — can you coordinate a single ticket that includes subnet expansion details so support doesn't triage separately? Also add 'allow temporary elastic IP limit bump for 14 days'.

joel: Will do. I'll update CLOUD-98734 with subnet expansion + requested AZ mapping. Also flag with provider contacts for faster review.

infra-bot: CLOUD-98734 updated with subnet expansion details. Added provider contact: support-rapid@cloudvendor.com.

priya: On the ops side I'll write playbook steps: 1) enable spot fallback flag, 2) provision warm pool with reduced model replicas, 3) run smoke tests against warm pool, 4) monitor model quality/regressions. I'll post the runbook link once ready.

simon: Anne — can finance approve the emergency commit and escrow the cap? We might not use full amount but need pre-approval to reserve capacity quickly.

anne: Approved up to $150k emergency. Condition: infra to provide post-mortem cost + usage report within 7 days of event end. Add billing-ops (linda@redwood.com) to tickets.

joel: Added linda@redwood.com to CLOUD-98734/98735. Also scheduled a provider call for tomorrow 09:00 PT.

simon: Thanks everyone. Priya/Joel/Tom — target to have tickets confirmed and fallback runbook ready by EOD tomorrow. If anything blocks, @simon will escalate. :+1:

priya: Will do. Posting runbook draft in #eng-infra once ticket confirmations arrive. :rocket:
